items.text: Open redirect on a trusted subdomain + loose redirect_uri validation on the OAuth client → craft an authorization URL that redirects the code to attacker infrastructure after a single victim click → exchange code for full account access

Loose `state` parameter validation + a login-CSRF gap → force-bind an attacker's third-party account to a victim's session, then use the linked account's elevated data-sharing scope to pull victim data on an ongoing basis
XSS on a low-traffic marketing subdomain that shares the parent domain's OAuth redirect_uri allow-list → use it to intercept authorization codes for the main app's login flow at scale

Implicit-flow access token leaked via Referer header from a third-party analytics script embedded in the post-login landing page → replay token to access the victim's account from attacker infrastructure
